blocks.text: Miss Universe Philippines Bea Millan-Windorski has departed for Puerto Rico where she will compete for the 2026 Miss Universe crown at the finals night set on Nov. 24 (Nov. 25 in the Philippines). Millan-Windorski looked radiant in a yellow Anthony Ramirez creation as she greeted pageant fans during her airport send-off. Photos and videos from the event were shared by MUPH on its social media pages on Thursday, Nov. 5.
